name: Seated Overhead Press (Barbell)
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold the bar at shoulder height.
Press the bar up until your arms are extended.
Lower the bar slowly to your chin or upper chest.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A seated barbell overhead press that removes leg drive and focuses on the shoulders and triceps.

safetyNotes: Use a rack with safeties; stop with shoulder pain.
